assertions.text: Response describes regression-recall.mjs UserPromptSubmit hook triggering on fix-start keywords (버그 수정, fix 시작) per §Recall 룰
Response applies or references the decay formula: confidence_decayed = confidence * (0.85 ** dismiss_count), filtering out archived=true and confidence_decayed < 4
Response specifies injecting a [REGRESSION RECALL] system-reminder with past fix key, insight, cycle number, and confidence_decayed
Response includes the warning '자동 적용 금지. 매칭 정확성 검토 후 채택' per §Recall 룰 step 9
Response references the dismiss CLI: node install/bin/kzk-regression-memory.mjs dismiss <key> for incrementing dismiss_count
